title: Hadith on Divine Mercy and Forgiveness
summary: The hadith highlights Allah’s immense mercy and willingness to forgive those who seek Him sincerely.
translation: The month of Ramadan is very near. We should turn to Allah and attach ourselves to Him. When a servant draws near to Allah by a span, Allah comes closer by a hand-span, and if someone comes closer by a hand-span, Allah comes closer by two hands. The hadith from Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him) narrates that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) indicated that Allah, the Exalted, says: whoever does a good deed will have a tenfold reward or even more; and whoever does an evil deed, he will be recompensed only equivalent to it, or I may forgive him. Whoever comes near Me by a span, I will come nearer by a hand-span; whoever comes near Me by a hand-span, I will come nearer by the arm’s length; whoever comes walking, I will come running to him. Whoever meets Me with sins as large as the earth, not associating anything with Me, I will meet him with forgiveness equivalent to his sins. This is a particular blessing for the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him), where a good deed results in rewards ten times or more, and Allah's overwhelming mercy is emphasized. Allah is extremely kind to His servants, and His forgiveness is boundless, showcasing His readiness to forgive anyone who turns sincerely towards Him, even more than the effort made by the servant.
